**Finding: Compliant (no redline).**

The LD rule is satisfied at the **preferred** level: there is no liquidated damages, penalty, minimum-fee-on-termination, or early-termination fee payable by AP anywhere in the Agreement.

Locations inspected:
- **§ 4(a) (p0016)** — the only termination-payment mechanic: "Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement." This is Kubient's actual revenue share on fees actually generated during the 90-day notice period, not a pre-agreed sum, and it is disapplied on termination for material breach. Not an LD.
- **§ 5 (p0023)** — pure revenue share flowing *from* Kubient *to* AP under sequential liability; no AP-payable fee floor or committed spend.
- **§ 13 (p0062)** — expressly no minimum revenue/profit guarantee in either direction, confirming the absence of any shortfall/true-up exposure.
- **§ 7(a) (p0027)** — mutual bar on punitive and similar damages.
- Targeted searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt*", "termination fee", "minimum", "shortfall", "forfeit", and "balance of the Term" returned no adverse mechanic.

Noted but not flagged under this rule: § 4(a) bars AP from terminating during the Initial Term except for material breach. That is a term/renewal point rather than an AP-payable liquidated amount, so it is left to the RENEWAL/termination rules rather than double-flagged here.
